notes:
THE MARKETPLACE BOARD, REBUILT.

TILES. The board is a grid now: the photo, then the price, then what it is and how old the listing is, then who has it. Which way the listing runs sits in the top-left corner of the photo and the quality in the top-right. Everything else moved one tap in.

A LISTING HAS ITS OWN PAGE. Tapping a card used to drop you straight into a private conversation with a stranger - a real commitment made from four lines of text. Now you get the photo at a size worth looking at, the quality range, how much is left, what they wrote, and their record. Buy and Sell live there.

UP TO FIVE PHOTOS, AND YOU FRAME THEM. A phone photo is the wrong shape for a tile, so something is always cut - it used to be cut by the app, after upload, and you found out when you saw the board. Now you drag and zoom, and what is in the frame is what the board shows.

ORE DOES NOT DIVIDE. Refined ore and RMC come out of a refinery in fixed containers, so 25 SCU is 25 SCU and the whole lot sells at once. Gems and gear are single items and can go in parts. You say which when you list, and a container is priced ONCE - for the lot, not per SCU - with the other figure echoed under the box so a price typed out of habit cannot quietly become a ninety-six-fold mistake.

YOU ARE TOLD WHEN SOMEBODY WANTS TO BUY. A notification when a stranger opens a conversation on your listing, and when they reply, mark a deal done, or a listing gets moderated. One ping until you look at it, so a chatty negotiation does not become five. It names the item and who, never the price or the place - it lands on a lock screen.

ALSO. Prices read short on tiles (~4M, 120K) and in full on the listing page. Listings show their age, so you can see what nobody is buying. "Verified only" is gone - it matched every row, because listing requires a proved RSI handle.

DATA. No Star Citizen data changed in this build.
